title: 삼 년 전 프로필
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop with elements of funk and disco. The arrangement features a slap bass line that follows a syncopated sixteenth-note pattern, locking with a punchy kick drum and a crisp snare. Clean, rhythmic electric guitar performs muted scratches and staccato chords. A bright brass section provides staccato stabs and melodic flourishes during transitions. The lead male vocals are energetic, utilizing a mix of chest voice and occasional falsetto in the higher register. Synthesizer pads provide harmonic density in the background. The tempo is 120 BPM in the key of G minor.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[slap bass, clean funk guitar, punchy drums]
[brass stabs]

[Verse 1]
[male vocals]
Rough-housed and I'm bundled up
거울 속의 머디 맨 (Muddy man)
대문 열릴 때마다 고개 들어 들어
아메리카노 벌써 [brass accents]
반이나 마셨어
심장만 두근거려

[Pre-Chorus]
[bass becomes more melodic, synth pads enter]
심장이 쿵쿵 뛰어 멈춰
손끝이 차가워
올까 말까 모르겠어
3년 전 나로 살아
거울 속엔 오늘에 나
웃겨 터져 저기 [drum fill]
들키면 안 되는데

[Chorus]
[full arrangement, energetic brass]
아메리카노 벌써
